title: US-01: As a student, I want to register with my school email.
body:
**Epic:** E1 · **Feature:** F1.1 · **Points:** 3 · **Priority:** Must · **Sprint:** 3 (MVP) · **Dependencies:** —

**User story**
As a student, I want to register with my school email.

**Acceptance criteria**
Only emails with the school domain are accepted, otherwise 400 `EMAIL_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED`; registering the same email a second time returns 409 `EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED`; the new account has the role STUDENT.

**Requirements (SRS):** FR-M1-01, FR-M1-02 – see `docs/sprint2/srs.md`

**Owner:** Mehmet

**Definition of Done:** PR linked to this Issue (`Closes #...`), at least 1 approval, tests written, consistent with OpenAPI.

title: US-02: As a user, I want to log in and access the screens for my role.
body:
**Epic:** E1 · **Feature:** F1.1 · **Points:** 3 · **Priority:** Must · **Sprint:** 3 (MVP) · **Dependencies:** US-01

**User story**
As a user, I want to log in and access the screens for my role.

**Acceptance criteria**
Valid credentials → 200 + JWT; invalid credentials → 401; no token → 401; unauthorized role → 403 `FORBIDDEN`; `GET /users/me` returns the caller's role.

**Requirements (SRS):** FR-M1-03, FR-M1-04 – see `docs/sprint2/srs.md`

**Owner:** Mehmet

title: US-04: As a user, I want to receive an in-app notification when the status of my booking changes.
body:
**Epic:** E2 · **Feature:** F2.1 · **Points:** 3 · **Priority:** Must · **Sprint:** 3 (MVP) · **Dependencies:** US-02

**User story**
As a user, I want to receive an in-app notification when the status of my booking changes.

**Acceptance criteria**
A notification is created for the affected user on approval, rejection, cancellation, office-hour cancellation, redirection and training authorization; GET /notifications returns only the caller's own notifications, newest first; a failure to create a notification is logged and does not roll back the operation.

**Requirements (SRS):** FR-M1-07, FR-M1-08 – see `docs/sprint2/srs.md`

title: US-06: As a student, I want to reserve a time slot for a lab device.
body:
**Epic:** E3 · **Feature:** F3.1 · **Points:** 8 · **Priority:** Must · **Sprint:** 3 (MVP) · **Dependencies:** US-02, US-11

**User story**
As a student, I want to reserve a time slot for a lab device.

**Acceptance criteria**
End before start → 400 `INVALID_INTERVAL`; **start in the past → 400 `INVALID_INTERVAL`**; device under maintenance → 409 `RESOURCE_IN_MAINTENANCE`; no valid lab approval → 403 `LAB_APPROVAL_REQUIRED`; no training authorization → 403 `TRAINING_REQUIRED`; overlaps a pending, approved or checked-in booking → 409 `SLOT_UNAVAILABLE`, also under concurrent requests; on success 201 + PENDING.

**Requirements (SRS):** FR-M2-01 … FR-M2-05 – see `docs/sprint2/srs.md`

**Owner:** Mürsel

**Definition of Done:** PR linked to this Issue (`Closes #...`), at least 1 approval, tests written, consistent with OpenAPI.

title: US-07: As a QA engineer, I want to verify the conflict engine and access rules with unit tests.
body:
**Epic:** E3 · **Feature:** F3.1 · **Points:** 5 · **Priority:** Must · **Sprint:** 3 (MVP) · **Dependencies:** US-06

**User story**
As a QA engineer, I want to verify the conflict engine and access rules with unit tests.

**Acceptance criteria**
Overlapping, nested and back-to-back ranges (10:00–11:00 and 11:00–12:00 do not conflict); start in the past; all combinations of approval/authorization present or missing; two concurrent requests for the same interval → exactly one succeeds (Testcontainers); M2 coverage at least 50%.

**Requirements (SRS):** FR-M2-06 – see `docs/sprint2/srs.md`

**Owner:** Mirac

**Definition of Done:** PR linked to this Issue (`Closes #...`), at least 1 approval, tests written, consistent with OpenAPI.

title: US-08: As a research assistant, I want to approve or reject pending lab requests.
body:
**Epic:** E4 · **Feature:** F4.1 · **Points:** 5 · **Priority:** Must · **Sprint:** 3 (MVP) · **Dependencies:** US-06

**User story**
As a research assistant, I want to approve or reject pending lab requests.

**Acceptance criteria**
RESEARCH_ASSISTANT/ADMIN only; rejection reason required (5–500 characters); only PENDING requests can be changed, otherwise 409 `INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION`; every transition is written to the status history; the student is notified (US-04).

**Requirements (SRS):** FR-M2-07, FR-M2-08, FR-M2-09 – see `docs/sprint2/srs.md`

**Owner:** Mürsel

**Definition of Done:** PR linked to this Issue (`Closes #...`), at least 1 approval, tests written, consistent with OpenAPI.

body:
**Epic:** E3 · **Feature:** F3.2 · **Points:** 2 · **Priority:** Must · **Sprint:** 3 (MVP) · **Dependencies:** US-06

**User story**
As a student, I want to cancel my reservation or appointment.

title: US-13: As an instructor, I want to grant a student lab access approval from an office-hour meeting.
body:
**Epic:** E6 · **Feature:** F6.1 · **Points:** 5 · **Priority:** Must · **Sprint:** 3 (MVP) · **Dependencies:** US-18, US-11

**User story**
As an instructor, I want to grant a student lab access approval from an office-hour meeting.

**Acceptance criteria**
INSTRUCTOR only; the appointment must be an office-hour appointment of the caller, otherwise 403; device category and end date required, end date in the past → 400; the approval is linked to the related appointment; the research assistant sees the approval in the lab panel; an expired approval is invalid.

**Requirements (SRS):** FR-M3-04, FR-M3-05, FR-M3-06 – see `docs/sprint2/srs.md`

title: US-14: As a research assistant, I want to record a completed device training and authorize the student.
body:
**Epic:** E6 · **Feature:** F6.2 · **Points:** 5 · **Priority:** Must · **Sprint:** 3 (MVP) · **Dependencies:** US-17, US-18, US-04

**User story**
As a research assistant, I want to record a completed device training and authorize the student.

**Acceptance criteria**
Authorization is created only when an appointment of type TRAINING is completed, otherwise 400 `NOT_A_TRAINING_APPOINTMENT`; authorization is per category and valid until the end of the semester; a second authorization for the same category → 409 `TRAINING_ALREADY_GRANTED`; the instructor who granted the approval receives an in-app notification (US-04).

**Requirements (SRS):** FR-M3-07, FR-M3-08 – see `docs/sprint2/srs.md`

**Owner:** Melih

body:
**Epic:** E7 · **Feature:** F7.1 · **Points:** 5 · **Priority:** Should · **Sprint:** Final · **Dependencies:** US-08

**User story**
As a research assistant, I want to hand over a device with a check-out code and receive its return.

**Acceptance criteria**
A 6-digit single-use code with an expiry is generated only for an approved reservation, otherwise 409; when verified → CHECKED_IN; a wrong, expired or reused code → 400 `INVALID_HANDOVER_CODE`; on return → COMPLETED.

**Requirements (SRS):** FR-M3-09, FR-M3-10 – see `docs/sprint2/srs.md`

title: US-17: As an instructor or research assistant, I want to define weekly office hours, support hours or training hours.
body:
**Epic:** E8 · **Feature:** F8.1 · **Points:** 5 · **Priority:** Must · **Sprint:** 3 (MVP) · **Dependencies:** US-02

**User story**
As an instructor or research assistant, I want to define weekly office hours, support hours or training hours.

**Acceptance criteria**
Type (OFFICE_HOUR, SUPPORT, TRAINING), day, time range and slot length (10–120 minutes) are entered; category required for TRAINING; an instructor may define only OFFICE_HOUR, a research assistant only SUPPORT and TRAINING, otherwise 403; the system generates the slots; the same person's hours cannot overlap (409 `SCHEDULE_OVERLAP`).

**Requirements (SRS):** FR-M4-01, FR-M4-02 – see `docs/sprint2/srs.md`

title: US-18: As a student, I want to book an appointment by writing my topic.
body:
**Epic:** E8 · **Feature:** F8.2 · **Points:** 5 · **Priority:** Must · **Sprint:** 3 (MVP) · **Dependencies:** US-17, US-06

**User story**
As a student, I want to book an appointment by writing my topic.

**Acceptance criteria**
Topic note required (10–500 characters), otherwise 400; full slot → 409 `SLOT_UNAVAILABLE`; at most one appointment per day with the same staff member (instructor or research assistant), otherwise 409 `DAILY_APPOINTMENT_LIMIT`; **slot already started → 400 `INVALID_INTERVAL`**; the appointment is stored as a reservation in M2 and is APPROVED immediately.

**Requirements (SRS):** FR-M4-03, FR-M4-04, FR-M4-05 – see `docs/sprint2/srs.md`

**Owner:** Emir
